SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: architecture search reached champion LPD-combine W=4 = 0.5047 @ 183p (seed42). But the unroll STILL initializes x0 from the raw Hann FBP -- the STREAKY starting point (the sparse-view problem itself). Wu-2015-trainable STANDALONE reaches hr 0.31 -> it produces a DE-ALIASED x0 that already beats raw FBP. (2) FAILURE MODE: raw-FBP x0 injects coherent streaks the K=30 unroll must then undo; a cleaner init could let the unroll climb higher. (3) ONE KNOB (architectural): wu_init_on=True -- I added a WuInit front-end (Wu aliasing-free band-decomposition FBP: 4 band scales + sigmoid slope + offset + 1 gain = 7 params) as a RESIDUAL on the plain FBP: x0 = fbp + gain*(wu_aliasfree - fbp), gain ZERO-INIT => x0 == plain FBP == the 0.5047 champion BYTE-FOR-BYTE at init (no regression). Trained END-TO-END with the DC+LPD unroll (init + LPD block + per-step alpha co-adapt). Total ~= 183 + 7 = 190 params. seed 42 to compare directly vs iter-15's 0.5047. (4) HYPOTHESIS: a learned de-streaked band-decomposition init feeds the DC+LPD unroll a cleaner starting image, so end-to-end training lifts hr past 0.5047 (the init and unroll co-adapt) -- OR the gain trains toward 0 (raw FBP already optimal for this unroll), a clean null. Either way maps the init lever. (5) BUDGET: WuInit = n_bands extra back-projections at x0 ONCE per forward (cheap vs K=30 unroll); iter-15 finished 16ep in 1020s -> expect ~14-16ep; train_n=200, max_train_s=1080, --time=00:30:00, 200-val -> 20-min comparable.
